selection_rule: Both candidate trials must improve actual physical steps per elapsed second over both controls, without worse maximum/p99 gaps or material/selected-pose age than the worse matched control. All correctness, actual actor visibility, memory/resource and ownership gates remain mandatory. A treatment with inconsistent primary improvement is NOT_ESTABLISHED, even if one native stage or CPU metric improves.

scope: Registered serial stockSafe native mechanism comparison on one9logicalCPU Linux host with actual1920x1080 llvmpipe; local g++14.2 explicit development toolchain drift. Not integrated resulting-source product, Windows or physicalGPU acceptance.
reason: Wave512 both candidate rates are lower than both controls, with adverse upper tails. Wave2048 primary improvement is inconsistent and material freshness is worse. The original primary throughput rule is decisively false independently of how finer freshness tradeoffs are summarized.
limits: Frozen candidate application predates lead resulting-source Water budget/picking integration and accepted-main reconciliation.
Wave512 is the frozen historical one-round/no-spill/no-ballistic profile;2048 uses the frozen gameplay_main846f profile.
Native World semantics cover mixed Sand/Water, but no medium/mixed/sustained gameplay performance expansion is justified for this rejected candidate.
Main submission ages are not GPU completion, compositor delivery, physical scanout or input-device-to-visible latency.
RSS and CPU observations span actual sampled process lifetime including setup; short runs do not establish long-session resource stability.
ASan/UBSan excludes LeakSanitizer; no leak-free claim.
